tools.name: get_language_options
tools.description: Return the supported Poly-Glot UI, input, and AI output languages. Language selection never changes entitlement and does not start the trial.

tools.name: get_subscription_status
tools.description: Return the current Poly-Glot entitlement state, trial status, daily free send allowance, feature locks, and pricing. This is the authoritative MCP-facing explanation of the user's access. Does not start the trial.

tools.name: open_workspace
tools.description: Open the interactive Poly-Glot template browser and prompt editor with subscription-aware locked states. Browsing does not start the trial or consume a send.

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Find Poly-Glot prompt templates. Results include whether each template is currently locked for this account. Searching does not start the trial or consume a send.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get a template's fields and prompt body. Opening a template does not start the trial or consume a send. The prompt body is returned only when the account is entitled.

tools.name: build_prompt
tools.description: Fill and Send an entitled Poly-Glot template. This is a Send action: it starts the 3-day free trial on first use if the user has not sent before. Pro templates require an active trial or Pro subscription.

tools.name: prepare_compare
tools.description: Prepare one canonical prompt for two or more AI providers so the user can compare answers. This is a Send action: it starts the 3-day free trial on first use. Compare Mode requires an active trial or Pro subscription. Never calls third-party models on the user's behalf.

tools.name: get_custom_model_capabilities
tools.description: Return supported BYOM adapter modes, credential policy, network restrictions, and notes about localhost access from the public remote MCP.

tools.name: validate_custom_model
tools.description: Validate a developer-supplied model endpoint. Checks HTTPS, SSRF, and optionally probes the model with a minimal request. API keys are transient and never persisted or echoed.

tools.name: run_custom_model
tools.description: Run a Poly-Glot prompt against a developer-supplied model endpoint. API keys are transient and never persisted. Respects Poly-Glot entitlement checks and applies language instructions.

tools.name: prepare_custom_compare
tools.description: Build a Compare Mode plan containing built-in Poly-Glot providers and developer-supplied custom model descriptors. Credentials are supplied only at execution time and are never embedded in the comparison plan.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe supplied audio for cross-platform Poly-Glot workflows. Provide exactly one of audioUrl (HTTPS only) or audioBase64.

tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Detect the language of supplied text and map it to a supported Poly-Glot language.

tools.name: translate_text
tools.description: Translate text into a supported Poly-Glot language. Preserves meaning, formatting, names, code, and URLs.

tools.name: localize_text
tools.description: Localize text for a target language, locale, audience, and tone — not merely literal translation.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_custom_compare" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
